manifest: one line per present head: head generation sha256
write_protocol: page temp + rename, then manifest temp + rename
root_digest: SHA-256 over sorted (head, generation, page_sha256) entries
missing_pages: allowed for partial checkpoints; only present heads are loaded
scope: host storage/provenance only; no page arithmetic or training
note: Atomic file replacement reduces torn-file exposure; it does not claim power-loss ordering on every filesystem.
